title: Data sources
intro: ADMIN-managed connections to the Jira Cloud projects and GitLab groups Flow ingests. Each connection runs its own sync schedule.
loadFailed: Could not load the data sources
notFound: This data source does not exist (or was deleted).

paused.title: Scheduled syncing is paused
paused.body: Scheduled syncs have been off since {{since}}: {{reason}}. Syncs in a row that stopped without storing anything: {{count}}. Data already synced stays and the reports keep working. Run "Sync now" or save the connection to resume.

reason.TIME_EXCEEDED: the time limit per run was hit

reconcilePaused.title: Scheduled reconcile is paused
reconcilePaused.body: The scheduled daily reconcile has been off since {{since}}: {{reason}}. Reconciles in a row that hit a limit: {{count}}. Scheduled syncs keep running and the data already synced stays. Run "Reconcile now" or save the connection to resume it.

job.scheduled: Waiting for further changes — starts after {{time}}

deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Its synced data is purged after a grace period.
deleteFailed: Could not delete the data source
deleteConflict: This data source cannot be deleted right now.
saveForbidden: Only administrators can manage data sources
saveConflict: A data source with this name already exists
saveConflictSite: All data sources must use the same Jira site as the existing ones
saveConflictProjects: One or more of these project keys already belong to another data source
saveConflictInstance: All GitLab data sources must read the same GitLab instance as the existing ones
saveConflictGroups: One or more of these groups overlap a group another GitLab data source already reads
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This data source no longer exists — reload the page

field.kindDisabledHint: GitLab is not enabled on this server (GITLAB_ALLOWED_HOSTS)
field.kindUnknownHint: Could not check which kinds this server offers; GitLab stays off until the page is reloaded
field.siteUrlHint: https://<tenant>.atlassian.net — fixed once the connection is created.
field.apiTokenKeep: Leave blank to keep the current token
field.projectKeysHint: Jira project keys, uppercase (e.g. ENG, OPS) — a project added here is downloaded at the next sync; a removed project's issues are hidden.
field.baseUrlHint: The instance origin (https://gitlab.example.com) — fixed once created. Allowed: {{origins}}
field.baseUrlHintOpen: The instance origin (https://gitlab.example.com) — fixed once created.
field.tokenHint: A personal access token with the read_api scope (plus admin_mode on an instance with Admin Mode on) — any other scope is refused.
field.tokenKeep: Leave blank to keep the current token
field.groupPathsHint: Full group paths (e.g. platform, platform/tooling); subgroups are included, archived projects are not
field.backfillFromHint: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) — leave blank for 24 months back (clearing it later resets to that). An earlier date re-reads the whole range once at the next sync; a later date keeps the data already downloaded, but it is no longer re-checked.
field.backfillFromHorizonHint: The history horizon allows dates from {{floor}} on; blank means 24 months back, or that day when it is later.

validation.siteUrlInvalid: Site URL must be exactly https://<tenant>.atlassian.net
validation.emailTooLong: Email must be at most 254 characters
validation.apiTokenTooLong: API token must be at most 1000 characters
validation.projectKeysInvalid: Invalid project key: {{key}} (uppercase letters, digits and underscores only)
validation.baseUrlInvalid: Base URL must be an origin such as https://gitlab.example.com (no path)
validation.baseUrlNotAllowed: This instance is not on the server's allow-list. Allowed: {{origins}}
validation.tokenTooLong: Access token must be at most 1000 characters
validation.groupPathsInvalid: Invalid group path: {{path}} (lowercase letters, digits, _ . - and / between subgroups)
validation.groupPathsNested: Group path {{path}} is inside another listed group — subgroups are included automatically
validation.syncIntervalRange: Sync interval must be between 5 and 1440 minutes
validation.reconcileHourRange: Reconcile hour must be between 0 and 23
validation.backfillFromInvalid: Backfill date must be an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
validation.backfillFromFuture: Backfill date must not be in the future
validation.backfillFromTooOld: Backfill date must not be before {{floor}}
validation.backfillFromBeforeHorizon: Backfill date must not be before {{floor}} (the history horizon)

test.rateLimited: Too many test attempts — wait a minute and try again
test.failedGeneric: Test connection failed. Check your connection and try again.

details.noCursors: No cursors yet — this connection hasn't synced.
details.jobsLoadFailed: Could not load the sync jobs
details.reprocessBody: Rebuilds the normalized layer from the raw store for every issue. This can take a while and never calls Jira.
details.cancelConflict: This job already finished — nothing to cancel.
details.actionDisabled: This data source is disabled — enable it first.

profile.title: Data profile
profile.empty: Run a sync to compute the profile.

inspect.title: Raw issue inspector
inspect.keyHint: A Jira issue key (e.g. ENG-123) or the stable numeric issue id.
inspect.empty: Look up an issue key or id to inspect its raw and normalized data.
inspect.invalidKey: Enter a valid issue key (e.g. ENG-123) or numeric id
inspect.notFound: No issue with that key or id was found for this data source
inspect.tooLarge: This issue's stored data is too large to inspect (over the processing page limit, JIRA_PROCESS_PAGE_BYTES).
inspect.notProcessed: This issue has not been through PROCESS yet.

toast.syncCoalesced: A sync is already in progress
toast.reconcileCoalesced: A reconcile is already in progress
toast.reprocessCoalesced: A reprocess is already in progress
